paper_title: Cooling of young neutron stars and dark gauge bosons
suggested_experiment_name: Cassiopeia A neutron star cooling (Cas A)
coupling_convention: e' (U(1)_{B-L} gauge coupling), dimensionless, plotted directly on y-axis
notes: Neutron star cooling (Cas A and NS1987A) bound on U(1)_{B-L} gauge boson. Conservative constraint e' < 5e-13 for m_gamma' < Tc(n3P2) ~ O(0.1) MeV = ~1e5 eV, encoded as mass-independent horizontal line. Paper also constrains dark photon (eps*m_gamma' < 1.5e-8 MeV), which would be a separate DarkPhoton limit, but the primary VectorBL result is extracted here per hint. Cas A also gives light-red region 1e-13<e'<5e-13; the 5e-13 conservative value used.
